title: Formspec Response Actions
description: Sidecar document declaring named response or app actions, FEL preconditions, validation tuple overrides, ordered effect requests, and invocation terminal controls. See specs/response-actions/response-actions-spec.md for normative prose.

actions.description: Application-scoped actions MUST each declare the explicit off/non-blocking/none validation tuple because no Response exists to supply intent defaults, validate, or persist.

$formspecResponseActions.description: Response Actions document version. MUST be '1.0'.

x-lm.intent: Version pin for Response Actions document compatibility

modules.description: OPTIONAL declaration of substrate modules this document depends on. Each entry is a canonical ModuleRef (id + version, with optional publisher + lockHash for posture admission). Default-module-set behavior per ADR 0150 §4.9 preserves form-only documents — omitting modules[] is identical to declaring the core module set. Per ADR 0150 §4.3.

version.description: Version of this Response Actions document. SemVer RECOMMENDED.

scope.description: Execution scope. response actions submit and validate the target Definition. app actions execute without a form submission and MUST omit targetDefinition.

url.description: Canonical URL of the Definition this Response Actions document binds to.

compatibleVersions.description: Version range or exact version expression accepted for the target Definition.

targetDefinition.description: The Definition this Response Actions document binds to. Identical role to Experience.targetDefinition.

actions.description: Named actions. Order is documentation-only; resolution is by Action.id. Each id MUST be unique within the document.

x-formspec-runtime.description: Typed runtime bindings for durable serviceRequest effects. The catalog describes request assembly and allowlisted outputs; the host retains origin, credential, authorization, tenant-scope, and network authority.

ActionInvocationStatus.description: Complete Response Action invocation status vocabulary. unresolved means that Action resolution failed before invocation; the remaining values are terminal execution outcomes.

ActionTerminalStatus.description: Terminal outcome returned after a Response Action invocation begins.

EffectOutcomeStatus.description: Outcome of one declared Action effect. not-invoked is an explicit owner-produced record, not an inference from a missing effect.

oneOf.description: Publisher-defined action intent extension per VM §6.1. MUST be paired with an explicit validation block on the Action; processors MUST NOT consult the master table for x- intents. The pattern forbids shadowing any standard VM ActionIntent name (x-save-draft, x-autosave, x-review, x-submit, x-request-evidence).

ActionIntent.description: Closed VM ActionIntent enum OR an x-prefixed publisher extension intent.

id.description: Unique within document. Starts with a letter; allows letters, digits, and hyphens.

actor.description: Optional free string naming the caller. Metadata only; MUST NOT be used for authorization.

label.description: Optional locale reference or literal label. Presentational only.

x-generation.description: Generation provenance for this rendered or user-invokable Action. Strict data-only authoring profiles require a direct need:<id>@<revision> anchor resolving to an adopted Need at its current revision.

preconditions.description: Optional ordered list of FEL preconditions.

effects.description: Ordered effect chain. Executes in declared order.

onFailure.description: Terminal behavior after a failing effect.

onDeferred.description: Terminal behavior after a deferred effect.

expression.description: FEL expression evaluated in the Response Actions host-binding catalog. MUST evaluate to a boolean.

severity.description: block terminates as blocked with cause=precondition; defer terminates as deferred.

ValidationOverride.description: Per-action full tuple replacement of the master-table triple. Predicate inherited via VM ValidationTuple.

IdempotencyKey.description: FEL expression evaluated once before a durable effect first executes and frozen across retries/replays.

eventKind.description: Published Respondent Ledger domain event kind. case.* and action.* lifecycle kinds MUST NOT be author-declared effects.

payloadRef.description: Optional FEL expression producing the event payload. Evaluated in the effect-time catalog.

LedgerAppendEffect.description: Durable effect requesting a Respondent Ledger append.

HandoffAssemblyEffect.description: Durable effect requesting Intake Handoff assembly.

EvidenceRequestEffect.description: Durable effect requesting demand-timing evidence collection.

requestRef.description: Identifier of one request in this document's x-formspec-runtime.requests catalog.

ServiceRequestEffect.description: Durable request for one host-admitted service operation. The effect names the request and owns ordering, retry, and idempotency; the runtime catalog owns transport binding.

detailRef.description: Optional FEL expression producing transient event detail.

HostEventEffect.description: Transient host-local event. MUST NOT carry idempotencyKey.

operation.description: open follows a safe internal, HTTPS, or explicitly authored mailto destination. download saves an authored resource.

resourceRef.description: Safe own-property path into the structured action input. The resolved value is a browser resource object; it is never evaluated as code.

target.description: Browsing context for open operations. Downloads ignore this value.

BrowserResourceEffect.description: Transient browser navigation or download request resolved from validated structured action input. MUST NOT carry idempotencyKey.

requests.description: Named request bindings. Each id MUST be unique within the catalog.

RuntimeRequestCatalog.description: Closed, typed runtime request catalog for this Response Actions document.

id.description: Stable request id referenced by serviceRequest.requestRef.

successStatuses.description: Optional exact successful HTTP status codes. Omission admits any 2xx response.

outputs.description: Allowlisted names extracted from the parsed JSON response. Outputs default to invocation-private. `transition` outputs may enter route state; the host sends `session` outputs only to its private session store.

x-generation.description: Generation provenance for this functional request declaration.

RuntimeRequest.description: One host-admitted JSON-over-HTTP request and its allowlisted outputs.

method.description: Mutation method. Read-only GET delivery belongs in Data Sources.

pathTemplate.description: Same-origin absolute-path template. Braced placeholders resolve only from pathBindings; hosts reject unsafe or malformed paths.

pathBindings.description: Bindings for every and only the named placeholders in pathTemplate. Resolved values MUST be scalar.

queryBindings.description: Optional query values. Resolved values MUST be scalar.

headerBindings.description: Optional non-authority request headers. Hosts MUST reject credentials, cookies, hop-by-hop headers, idempotency-key, and Formspec scope headers.

bodyDefaults.description: Optional literal JSON object copied before bodyBindings are applied.

bodyBindings.description: JSON Pointer targets populated from runtime selectors after bodyDefaults are copied.

HttpJsonRequest.description: Structured same-origin JSON request. Base origin, credentials, authorization, scope headers, and idempotency header remain host-owned.

path.description: Safe own-property path into the selected structured source.

value.description: Literal JSON value when from is literal.

path.description: JSON Pointer into the parsed successful response body.

exposure.description: `internal` remains invocation-private; `transition` MUST resolve to a non-empty string and may be consumed by Surface transition params; `session` MUST resolve to a non-empty string, and the host sends it only to its private session store for later `from: session` selectors.

RuntimeRequestOutput.description: Allowlisted response extraction. Raw response bodies never enter effect traces or navigation state. Session outputs never enter invocation results or diagnostics.
